Topic: Mandatory Pacer Section 1: Big Jack Mountain
Details: Must be paced by ONLY 1 support crew member on the ascent of Big Jack Mountain (57.3-64.1 km). Keep to LEFT-hand side of road.

Topic: No Crew Support Zone: Start to Towamba
Details: Support crews MUST NOT stop, slow down to talk, or support runners anywhere between Boydtown Beach (0 km) and CP1 Towamba (24.5 km). Drive directly to Towamba and park past Pericoe Rd junction.

Topic: 1 Active Vehicle / Max Length 5.5m / No Campervans
Details: Max 1 registered support vehicle active at a time (shift vehicles only swap at mandatory CPs). 4WD strongly recommended; sedan/wagon/ute/HiAce van OK up to MAX 5.5 metres length. Campervans/motorhomes & vehicles >5.5m PROHIBITED. No bikes/scooters/e-scooters.

Display A4 runner number sticker on rear right/driver-side window. Affix yellow/black 'Runners Ahead' (rear) & 'Runners Following' (front) signs from Towamba onwards (return after race). Hazard lights OR amber roof beacon ON at all times on course.

Maximum 40 km/h while actively supporting on course. Leapfrog ~5 km ahead, park completely off road (never under trees, never blocking driveways/gates, NEVER on Beloka climb). Never shadow/crawl behind runner or hand off from a moving car.

Run on extreme RIGHT-hand side facing oncoming traffic at all times EXCEPT: (1) Big Jack Mountain ascent (keep LEFT, 57.3-64.1 km), (2) Beloka Hill ascent (keep LEFT, 162-165 km). CRITICAL REMINDER: Bibbenluke / Monaro Hwy MUST run RIGHT (officials impose time penalties here).

Cross major highways/junctions ONLY at cones under Official direction (0.5, 3.7, 23.9, 37.0, 65.9, 81.6, 106.6, 181.6 km). If leaving route for public toilet/aid, MUST return to EXACT departure point.

Topic: No Start Toilets, Dalgety Rule & Leave No Trace
Details: NO toilets at Boydtown Beach (bushes prohibited). Dalgety Hall indoor toilets = RUNNERS ONLY (crew use building 50-100m behind hall). Pack out ALL waste/toilet paper/rubbish in crew vehicle; never leave human waste near Summit Path; never climb summit cairn.

Life-threatening emergency: CALL 000 FIRST, then WhatsApp Race Control (Bib/Name/Location/Issue). Telstra SIM strongly recommended (most officials carry Starlink).
